text: Ladies and gentlemen, the judge has climbed into the ring! Yes, your announcer built this one, so the realism score comes from the owner, not from me. Folks, my fighter's feet were floating two to seven centimeters off the mat. Embarrassing! Now every stance, punch, hit and kick is grounded, hips dropped, both feet flat in guard. Standing one point seven three meters, packing over one hundred sixty-five thousand triangles, the patient counter-striker who finally touched down, the former Hovercraft herself, CLAUDE!
